items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: He told me out there, he said, Brown, I'm gonna write a number, slap at the bass.

ctx.x: Freddie Grofey wrote a number out, do you remember slapping the bass? Remember? He told me out there, he said, Brown, I'm gonna write a number, slap at the bass. He wrote it, and I don't know what... orchestrations, I guess he could get the bass players to play it much, you know?

Well, you were the one and the new one each day That kept my way off our gathering too If I gave myself the time to think about you I'd go mad to think that I'm without you Each night now I pray that I may find a way Find a way off our getting you
